quality_controls.detail: All final record_id values are unique.
Every row has endpoint, raw value, raw unit, target species/class, and source locator.
No database-only annotation is treated as primary activity evidence.
No sentence fragments or prose-derived target labels remain.

limitations: Supplemental Figures S3/S4/S5 were present inside DOCX as TIFF media, but no structured supplementary value table was locally parseable; exact source-text values were used where stated and figure-only exacts were not fabricated.
μM values are preserved as reported; no μg/mL to μM conversion was performed.
